title.narrative: SO 2.1. Number of submitted consumer petitions

description.narrative: The indicator measures the number of consumer protection related petitions. In Moldova we have a rate of only 17 consumer petitions per 10000 inhabitants. In Romania for 2023 this indicator was of 59 petitions per 10k inhabitants. The target value for this indicator is 23 consumer petitions per 10k inhabitants by the end of 2025.The indicator is a proxy to measure the consumer awareness, and the credibility in the consumer protection authorities.

comment.narrative: We are looking forward to a 36 increase in the number of consumer petitions due to the impact of the Action.

title.narrative: OO1.1. Quality of interinstitutional coordination on consumer protection

description.narrative: Measures the interinstitutional cooperation and the way institutions vested with consumer protection powers allocate sufficient administrative resources for the fulfillment of their duties, as well as the transparency of these authorities.

comment.narrative: The Coordination Council became a lucrative body that is meeting regularly and has a leading role in coordinating the activities of all responsible authorities. The annual report of the State Inspectorate shows clearly that the responsible authorities are transparent and provide sufficient and comparable qualitative and quantitative date on their role in enforcing the consumer protection framework.

project recordsQuality control comment August 2023 This values of 2326 605 female and 1721 male has been set to 0. Final report. The value of 12284 corresponds to 5 contributions to EURF 2.15 814 954 8048 2326 105 In all of them the EURF indicator was encoded as a logframe indicator and there arent comments in OPSYS to clarify to what it corresponds to the justification of the match and any calculations involved. From the narrative of the report is also unclear to know if there is double counting amongst the individuals reported under the different values. It is therefore decided to only report the highest value of all of them 8048 which corresponds to the number of youth registered and successfully completed skill development courses.
